Which area should we look in?
Pick an area and I'll show hospital information and official contact channels.
bot.hospitals: In Hospital Info you can see matching hospitals sorted by distance or name. Please check each hospital’s official contacts and opening hours.
bot.price: You can see price ranges by treatment in the Price Guide. Actual costs vary, so please confirm with the hospital.
bot.interpret: Interpreter support varies by hospital. Please check supported languages through the hospital’s official contact before visiting. For travel interpretation, you can call the 1330 Korea Travel Hotline.
bot.tour: Daegu travel information is coming soon. Avoid a heavy schedule right after treatment, and check recovery advice with your hospital.
bot.emergency: This may be an emergency. Call 119 now or go to the nearest emergency room. 119 offers foreign-language interpretation.

chat.disclaimer: AI answers are for information only. Please confirm treatment and bookings with the hospital.
